_style: Draw a new square icon for the same pictogram set as the attached image: use the attached image ONLY as the style reference (same painterly gouache technique, bold black ink outlines, warm peach skin tone, plain soft grey background, same level of detail) but draw completely different content: {WHAT} Every face is a generic featureless bald humanoid head; a face 'in profile facing right' means a strict side view of the head and neck filling the left half of the icon, cropped like a bust. Centred composition, readable at 40 pixels. No text, no letters, no border, no frame.
_auras: Aura symbols, always drawn exactly like this: TANAGA = a bold blue angular glyph shaped like a stylised number 4 (a short diagonal stroke rising to a tall vertical stroke); KATSIN = a yellow sparkle made of eight thin straight rays radiating from a small centre, like an asterisk; SHIAL = a bold red ring with a solid red dot in its centre, like a target.
